analysis_status: Integrated as OpenStreetMap community-mapped context only; not an authoritative inventory or exposure input.
geographic_coverage: Query rectangle only: 76.2373589–76.3400293 E, 9.8934161–10.0497693 N. This is not a validated or complete Kochi Corporation boundary.
license: Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0; © OpenStreetMap contributors. Attribution required; database adaptations are subject to ODbL share-alike terms.
limitations: Community mapping is not an authoritative inventory; completeness, positional accuracy, access, condition, and operational status are not independently validated.
The query rectangle was derived from the observed extent of a provisional ward snapshot and is not a legal or complete city boundary.
Only tagged OSM highway ways meeting the recorded filter are included; mapped bridges are road ways tagged with bridge=* and may not be a complete bridge register.
These layers provide map context only. They are not used to calculate route availability, hazard exposure, damage, service disruption, or consequences.
ODbL attribution and share-alike obligations apply to these derived databases.
processing_filter: OSM highway ways with highway in: motorway, motorway_link, primary, primary_link, secondary, secondary_link, tertiary, tertiary_link, trunk, trunk_link
source_coordinate_order: Source OSM point geometry uses lat/lon; converted to GeoJSON [longitude, latitude] order.
title: OpenStreetMap major road ways in the Kochi review rectangle (context only)
units: Line geometries and OpenStreetMap tags; tag values are not uniformly measured quantities

validation.intersection_method: Planar topological overlay in longitude/latitude (EPSG:4326); boundary counts as intersection; no distance/area calculation.
